# Yang–Mills frontier audit

Strongest defensible level: **C2 — rigorous restricted-model theorem**.

## Pass/fail matrix

| Frontier item | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Finite-lattice theorem is self-contained | pass | Geometry, conditional law, rate, stability, and criterion consequence are proved. |
| Gauge-invariant local event | pass | Plaquette distance is conjugation invariant. |
| Microscopic conditioning is gauge reduced | fail / not required | Dobrushin calculation deliberately uses raw link coordinates. |
| Boundary quantifiers are explicit | pass | Worst-boundary and open-neighborhood suprema are distinguished. |
| Positivity at the regulator level | pass | Finite heat-kernel density is strictly positive. |
| Locality at the regulator level | pass | Conditional kernel uses only incident plaquettes. |
| Volume-uniform estimate | absent | Block is fixed and finite. |
| Lattice-spacing uniformity | absent | No lattice-spacing parameter appears. |
| Continuum existence | absent | No Schwinger-function limit or measure construction. |
| Reflection positivity / OS reconstruction | absent | Not used or claimed. |
| Observable completeness | absent | One local plaquette event only. |
| Nontrivial continuum theory identity | absent | No continuum object. |
| Hamiltonian spectral gap | absent | No transfer matrix or Hamiltonian. |
| Confinement or physical mass | absent | Explicitly not claimed. |

## Parameter and limit ledger

`d`, `B_d`, `G`, metric, `z`, `rho`, link, and target plaquette are fixed. Heat time tends to zero. The result is dimensionless in the chosen group metric. There is no conversion from the heat-time concentration exponent to physical units.

## First unproved implication toward Yang–Mills

The paper does not prove a weighted boundary or contour estimate under the full interacting measure. Before any continuum question, one would need a volume- and scale-uniform mechanism that retains the energetic/entropic cost of adverse boundary data. Even that would still precede continuum construction, universality, Osterwalder–Schrader reconstruction, and a Hamiltonian mass gap.

## Mandatory public description

“This is a finite-lattice obstruction to boundary-uniform local defect domination and to the microscopic single-link Dobrushin row criterion. It does not construct continuum Yang–Mills theory, prove confinement, or establish a mass gap.”

Title, abstract, introduction, discussion, and conclusion all satisfy this downgrade language.
